name: Elijah Carnazzo
biography: Raised on the central coast of California, Elijah was classically trained in trombone performance starting at the age of 6. He found his passion for theatre arts in high school and spent his early professional career in the Pacific Northwest working in the independent film scene. He is known for Penelope (2024) and Voicemails for Isabelle (2026). He currently resides in California.
